messages:
maria (support): Hi team — acme-admin reports they suddenly can't access their project console, getting 403 on all console routes. Started after we rotated a service identity earlier today. Can we triage?
acme-admin: Yep, lost access at ~09:10 UTC. I can view the org but clicking into the project shows 'Permission denied (403)'. No UI buttons, everything grayed out.
acme-admin: We tried logging out / incognito, same.
maria (support): Thanks. Can you paste the org/project IDs and the user display email? Also did you notice any new SSO prompts?
acme-admin: org=org-0456, project=proj-acme-1, user=alice@acme.com. No SSO prompt, just 403.
maria (support): Logged a ticket #INC-8321 and asking eng/sre to look at auth logs. fyi tagging @emma and @jason.
emma (eng): Looking. Any service account or delegated token used by your console session?
acme-admin: We have a background automation that swaps a service identity for deployments — rotation happened ~08:55. Could be related.
jason (sre): Pulling authz logs for org-0456. One sec.
deploy-bot: action=service-key-rotate actor=infra-ops target=sa:infra-deploy-01 time=1702002100 result=success scopes=[projects:read,deploy:invoke]
jason (sre): I see a rotation event from deploy-bot at 08:55. The new key appears to have scopes: projects:read,deploy:invoke — missing console/admin scope. When the SA was re-bound to sessions we issued tokens without the full scope.
jason (sre): The console uses the token chain to assert project roles. Because the token omitted the "projects:console:admin" scope during the rebind, role claims weren't re-propagated -> 403.
maria (support): So the user's direct login should still show roles unless the role propagation job uses that SA?
emma (eng): We have a periodic role-propagation worker that runs on events from service-identity changes. It uses the rotated key to call the role-sync API. If that key lacks the console scope, the sync writes partial bindings. That matches what we see.
amc-admin: Is there a quick workaround so the customer can access the project now?
jason (sre): Short term: stop-gap is to re-run the role-sync using an admin key or restore previous SA key. I can run a manual sync for org-0456. Confirm you want us to proceed?
amc-admin: Please run it. We need access restored for engineering.
jason (sre): Running manual sync now...
deploy-bot: action=role-sync-start org=org-0456 initiated_by=jason time=1702003320
jason (sre): Sync finished. Can you try again, @acme-admin?
amc-admin: Trying... still 403.
maria (support): Jason— any errors in the sync?
jason (sre): The first sync ran but reported partial failures: api: /internal/assign returned 403 for some service-bound writes. Looking at logs, the sync attempted to call with the rotated key and hit scope-denied on some endpoints. I retried with my personal admin key and forced a full reconciliation.
jason (sre): Second run completed with status=ok at 1702003375. All role bindings for proj-acme-1 should be restored.
amc-admin: Refreshing... console is back. Buttons clickable, I can see project settings. Thank you. :tada:
maria (support): Great — root cause: service identity rotation omitted required console scope which caused role-propagation worker to write incomplete bindings.
emma (eng): Action items: (1) update rotation playbook to ensure rotated keys include projects:console:admin and role-sync scopes, (2) add a validation step in rotation job to verify token scopes before replacing active key, (3) add alert when role-sync reports partial failures.
amc-admin: Can you also share what caused the new key to be created without the scope? Our infra pipeline created it automatically.
emma (eng): We'll audit the rotation pipeline. Preliminary: the key creation template used a compact scope set for deploy-only jobs; a recent templating change trimmed console scopes. We'll patch the template.
maria (support): Adding a note to the support ticket and emailing the customer that access is restored and we're following up with a permanent fix.
jason (sre): Logged follow-up tasks: TASK-1298 (patch rotation template), TASK-1299 (validate rotation), TASK-1300 (alert on partial role-sync).
amc-admin: Thanks everyone. Please cc when fixed.
maria (support): Will do — closing thread for now, re-open if it recurs.
